title: MZ Question about SV Battlers spritesheets

posts.author: Jeenah
posts.body:
Hello there ! Does anyone knows if there's a descriptive and comprehensive file about the SV Battlers for MZ ?
(I want to know what does what on the spritesheet, because i'm lost).
I know the first three are the IDLE in battle, the second one is the second idler after selecting the action, i know the very last one is dead sprite.
I guessed the 3rd layer is for the guard stance, but ... To what action correspond he other ones ? I didn't find a casting one for magic, which is very sad since i'll be using a dragon as a playable party member. Not having the ability to have a spite animation for magic is very sad :')
Link to Gryphon Battler

Oh my, this update is absolutely marbleous! It's truly in-spire-ing how well-polished these rock-solid sprites are. You can't help but love it to pebbles!:kaojoy:  Hmm, i'd love to see a Panda, preferably a bipedal one. Oh and maybe with a straw hat, too!
